name: get_automation_link_stat
description: Get Automation Click Tracking Stats by ID (GET /marketing/stats/automations/{id}/links). The id argument is the exact opaque primary key, not a human name, title, external code, or numeric code suffix.

id.description: The ID of the Automation you want to get click tracking stats for. The id argument is the exact opaque primary key, not a human name, title, external code, or numeric code suffix.

group_by.description: Automations can have multiple steps. Including `step_id` as a `group_by` metric allows further granularity of stats.

step_ids.description: Comma-separated list of `step_ids` that you want the link stats for.

page_size.description: The number of elements you want returned on each page.
